purpose_context: This is wave-2 mission M3 of the muster <-> spec-kitty agent-conformance programme, building on M1's conformance/ tree and CI skeleton (merged at 32722b5f1). It hand-authors SOP rule manifests under conformance/doctrine/ for the 9 trace-decidable directives plus >=4 high-value judge directives, each rule's ruleText verbatim from the directive's own integrity_rules line so muster's RULE_DRIFT lint turns upstream directive edits into visible staleness. A jq gate parses muster sop run's --json output in CI because drift findings are warnings that do not flip the exit code, and a deliberately-drifted control manifest proves the drift detector itself fires. Zero muster changes; behavioral probes are deferred to wave-2 mission M4.
purpose_tldr: Turn spec-kitty's built-in directives into machine-checkable SOP rule manifests that muster's RULE_DRIFT lint gates on every PR.
